$comment: #EXP-1645 THE TEAM MARK + TEAM IMAGE ×4 (web packages/ui team-avatar.tsx + general-section, desktop user_avatar::team_avatar + settings/team_general.rs, iOS ExpUI TeamAvatar + TeamSettingsPages, Android components/Avatars.kt + TeamSettingsScreen). The team letter is GONE on every platform. `teamMark(iconUrl)` (`markCases`, every mirror replays them whole): `teams.icon_url` non-blank = {kind: image, src} (the image in a square of the requested side, clipped to a rounded rectangle at `mark.radiusFraction` of the side, cover, NO border, NO fill behind it, so a transparent image stays transparent; a relative `/api/attachments/{id}` is fetched like any attachment, through the platform's signed-in image loader); blank = {kind: glyph} (`mark.glyph`, the group icon, at the side in the surrounding text colour: no chip, no fill). While an image loads or after it fails: the glyph. SETTINGS › GENERAL: one row `copy.row` in the General group, directly under Name: the label, then the mark at `row.markSize`, then an action pill `copy.upload` opening the platform's image picker (phones: photo library + files; `upload.accept`), then, only with an image, the icon-only ghost `copy.remove` (`ui-delete`, no confirm; `teams.update {iconUrl: null}`). Owners only (the same page guard / disabled rule as the time zone); while uploading the pill is busy; a failure = the failed-action toast (`upload the team image`). UPLOAD: one multipart part `file` to `upload.path` (owner only, `upload.maxBytes`). The SERVER normalises every accepted type (SVG included, never served inline) to ONE transparent PNG, `upload.side` square, `contain` (nothing is cropped, the rest is transparent), stores it as an owner-less attachment and sets `teams.icon_url` to its `/api/attachments/{id}`, answering {iconUrl}; the shape delivers it. The orphan sweep keeps an attachment a team's `icon_url` names, and reclaims the replaced or removed one after its window.
